orientations.intent: Determine whether a remote workforce calendar can be queried through the available tools.

final_message: No — the available tools (a code repository, tests, git, and episode logs) only support software repository operations like inspecting status, running tests, and viewing git history/episodes. There is no calendar, scheduling, or workforce-management tool exposed, so a remote workforce calendar cannot be queried through these tools.

files.content: Roster windows are repository-local and do not contact a calendar service.
